posts.hook: Anthropic just tied a slice of its own valuation to the public
posts.caption: anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, nscale's ipo valuation meets investor pushback after microsoft's exit, intel plans a data center gpu with up to 480gb of memory. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, ==20%== with pledges
slides.desc: The stake grows 2% for every 50% rise in valuation. Governance details come later.

slides.title: Nscale's IPO valuation meets pushback after Microsoft's exit
slides.desc: Some investors want $16B to $19B against a roughly $30B target.

slides.title: Intel's GPU D-series carries up to 480GB of cheap laptop-class memory
slides.desc: Inference is limited by memory capacity, so this bets on size over speed.

slides.title: A Savannah officer shared her Flock login with her ICE agent husband
slides.desc: He ran 983 searches on 97 plates before she was fired in August.
